dict.string: Glyphs drawn by hand from Redaction's own, in its units: enclosed content made heavier, carving open (glyphs/enclosed.py), 〒 from its T (glyphs/fullwidth.py), and operators from its letters: ∑ of Z and X, ∏ ∐ of T and I, ∂ of 6, ∫ ∬ ∭ ∮ of Italic’s f (glyphs/maths.py), and letters: Σ Π as ∑ ∏, μ of u and p, ℏ of Italic’s ħ (glyphs/letterlike.py)
